item.title: Harry Styles’ Together, Together Tour 2026 Setlist: Every Song Played at First Show
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about Harry Styles' new tour, Together, Together. The Grammy-winning singer kicked off his tour at Amsterdam's Johan Cruyff Arena, and it's already making waves.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Gone are the sequins and ruffles of his previous tour, For Love On Tour. This time around, Styles is embracing a more business casual vibe, inspired by his "Aperture" music video. Think oversized ties, velvet blazers, and short shorts. The crowd of 56,000 fans was treated to a 21-song setlist that took them on a journey from fantasy to reality and back again.
[Short music clip from Harry Styles plays]
Host: The setlist included reworked versions of fan favorites like "Matilda," a mashup of "Carla's Song" and "Satellite," and "Treat People With Kindness." But what about his biggest hits and deep cuts? Styles delivered, with a mix of old and new songs that had the crowd singing along.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: The Together, Together tour will be making stops in London, São Paulo, Mexico City, New York City, Sydney, and Melbourne throughout the year. And, in a special honor, the Johan Cruyff Arena has installed a permanent pillar mural to celebrate its role as Styles' first "home base" for the tour.
[Outro music starts to play]
Host: We'll be keeping an eye on the tour as it evolves, and who knows, the setlist may change from night to night. But for now, it's clear that Harry Styles is back and better than ever. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
